info.title: Photon feature coverage fixture
info.description: Every OpenAPI 3.1 / JSON Schema 2020-12 construct in config/openapi-features.json. Generated SDKs from it must pass the naming gate and differential conformance in both lanes.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes the request safe to retry.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: Lower-case spelling of a case-insensitive header.

requestBody.description: Two parts: JSON metadata, then the file bytes.

post.description: Starts an export job and acknowledges it with an empty 202.

post.summary: Exchange a grant for an access token
post.description: Unauthenticated, JSON or form encoded, with OAuth errors rather than problems and no default response.

429.description: Too many token requests; the response has no body.

get.description: Accepts an account service key or an OAuth grant, declares the Authorizer's problem responses and no default response.

parameters.name: default
parameters.description: A parameter named after a keyword.

get.summary: Check whether a widget name is free

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A required query parameter with validation keywords.

SettingValue.description: A type array of scalars: a union of its members in every SDK.

OverrideCode.description: A type array of scalars with null.

SortOrder.description: Optional property whose default is on the referenced component (not nullable).

PlatformIdentifier.description: A messaging platform: one this SDK knows, or one added later.

Contact.description: A contact on a platform. The SDKs read a platform added later as UnknownContact.

Note.description: A note sent or received on a platform. The SDKs read a platform added later as UnknownNote.

WidgetDefaultFilter.description: Whether to count only the default widget (true) or only the others (false).

TokenRequest.description: A grant; the members are told apart by grant_type.

TokenError.description: An OAuth 2.0 error response (RFC 6749 section 5.2), not a problem.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: True when this response was replayed.

Sunset.description: When this operation stops being served.

oauth2.description: OAuth grant from the fixture authorization server.
